subject: english
purpose: Broaden substantively distinct lexical content for faithful CUET2024 synonym/antonym skill adaptations; this source artifact creates no published item.
selection_notes: All 25 target definitions were observed in successful web.open results from official Oxford Learner's Dictionary pages.
Dictionary usage labels and sense qualifiers are separate from the exact quoted definition text.
Definitions are brief full sense definitions; each quote is under 25 words. No dictionary example sentence is copied.

The target list spans generosity, economy, determination, openness, diligence, aggression, density, disuse, prudent judgement, boredom, detail, danger, exertion, logical clarity, visibility, bias, inevitability, calm, authenticity and joy. The additional five targets cover brevity, sociability, pride, weakness and short duration.
Diligent and meticulous intentionally test distinct effort-versus-detail meanings; use the supplied sense context to preserve the distinction.
Synonym/antonym pairs are authoring ideas, not an independent answer-validation receipt or a guarantee that a future option set is unique.

syllabus_fit.authority_note: The official English syllabus in the checked blind bundle explicitly names Synonyms and Antonyms; 2027 applicability remains provisional.
syllabus_fit.historical_fit: Retain direct synonym/antonym or contextual closest-meaning skill, four grammatically parallel ordered alternatives, and one defensible best answer. Target substitution alone does not confer authentic-PYQ status.

retrieval_failures.cambridge_attempt: Official Cambridge pages for benevolent/frugal/reluctant/candid/diligent returned 403 or unexpected status; no snippet definitions used.
retrieval_failures.oxford_attempt: Scarce failed; replaced with successfully retrieved sparse. Reluctant was observed but excluded because its full definition exceeded the brief-quotation limit; resolute is the replacement. The unsuffixed transient URL failed; its official adjective entry transient_1 was retrieved successfully. Haughty was observed as relation evidence but not added as a target because its full definition exceeded the requested 14-word limit; arrogant supplies the concise target.

permissions_and_limits.notes: Attributed short quotations for local source evaluation do not establish unrestricted republication permission.
